sources.entry: Gotify - Notification server with Android and CLI clients (alternative to PushBullet). (Source Code, Clients) MIT Go/Docker
Gotify | Simple server for sending and receiving push messages

summary.what_it_does: The server lets you send messages through a REST API and receive them over WebSocket. It includes user, client and application management. The README lists a Web-UI in ./ui, a CLI for sending messages (gotify/cli), and an Android app (gotify/android). Plugins are mentioned as a feature but the README gives no details. Install, configuration, REST-API and dev-environment docs are linked from the README but not included in it.
use_cases: send alerts from scripts via REST API
notable: Companion Android app and CLI client in separate repositories
caveats: README does not include install or run steps; they are in separate documentation
Clients (Android, CLI) live in separate repositories
